# Test data

Everything here is public: no personal data, no private keys of real people, no real signed documents.

| Folder | Contents | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `certificates/historical/` | Certificates of Ukrainian certification authorities issued in 2005 – 2015 (expired) | `ua-cryptography-pki` certificate tests |
| `certificates/czo-roots/` | Current self-signed roots of the Central Certification Authority (ЦЗО) | `ua-cryptography-pki` trust-anchor and chain tests |
| `certificates/intermediates/` | Current qualified providers' CA certificates ("Дія", PrivatBank) | `ua-cryptography-pki` chain tests |
| `certificates/nbu-roots/` | The root of the National Bank's certification centre | `ua-cryptography-pki` chain tests |
| `vectors/` | DSTU 7624 reference vectors produced by BouncyCastle Java | `ua-cryptography-dstu7624` |
| `oracle/` | Answers of the C# implementation's test oracles (BouncyCastle, `System.Security.Cryptography.Xml`) and signatures of a synthetic PKI, recorded by `tools/csharp-oracle`; each folder has a README | every crate's oracle tests |

The keys under `oracle/` are synthetic, generated by `tools/csharp-oracle` for the tests only. Never add real
signatures, key containers (`.jks`, `.pfx`, `Key-6.dat`, `*.ZS2`, …) or certificates of natural persons here:
`.gitignore` refuses the common key-container extensions everywhere except `oracle/`.
